findings.title: Final stage never sets USER, so the container runs as root
findings.detail: No USER in the final stage (or the stages it builds on), so the process runs as root unless `python:latest` sets a non-root user itself.
findings.fix: Create an unprivileged user and add `USER <name or uid>` to the final stage.

findings.title: Base image uses the :latest tag
findings.detail: `python:latest` moves whenever upstream publishes; builds are not reproducible.
findings.fix: Pin a version tag, e.g. `FROM node:22-alpine`, ideally with a digest.

findings.title: apt lists not removed in the same RUN
findings.detail: The apt package lists stay in this layer (tens of MB) and go stale.
findings.fix: End the RUN with `&& rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*`, or use a `--mount=type=cache` for /var/lib/apt.

findings.title: apt-get install without --no-install-recommends
findings.detail: apt-get pulls recommended packages by default, which bloats the image and the attack surface.
findings.fix: Add `--no-install-recommends` so only required packages are installed.

findings.title: apt lists not removed in the same RUN
findings.detail: The apt package lists stay in this layer (tens of MB) and go stale.
findings.fix: End the RUN with `&& rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*`, or use a `--mount=type=cache` for /var/lib/apt.

findings.title: ADD used where COPY is enough
findings.detail: ADD has implicit behaviour (remote fetch, archive extraction); COPY is explicit.
findings.fix: Use COPY for local files; keep ADD only for auto-extracting local tar archives.

findings.title: pip install without --no-cache-dir
findings.detail: pip keeps downloaded wheels in ~/.cache/pip inside the layer.
findings.fix: Add `--no-cache-dir` (or `ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1`, or a cache mount).

findings.title: Shell-form CMD: the app runs under /bin/sh -c
findings.detail: The process runs as a child of `/bin/sh -c`, which may not forward signals.
findings.reference: hadolint DL3025; Docker build check JSONArgsRecommended

findings.title: Final image has no HEALTHCHECK
findings.detail: Docker and Compose can't tell whether the app is healthy.
findings.fix: Add a HEALTHCHECK for plain Docker/Compose/Swarm. Kubernetes ignores it and uses probes instead.

findings.title: Whole build context copied
findings.detail: The whole build context is copied into the image, so whatever .dockerignore doesn't exclude (.git, .env, keys) ends up in a layer.
findings.fix: Check that .dockerignore excludes .git, .env*, credentials and build output, or copy explicit paths.
